data.narrative:
Ark Robotics is a seed-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Achi Takagama. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 private and 2 public firms operating in defense technology, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

A peer-median approach was applied using three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). This method yielded a median implied valuation of $400M, with the peer range spanning $125M to $1.0B. The peer-median approach represents the only triangulation method with sufficient data applicability at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered on $400M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-peer sample—particularly the wide spread between UFORCE at $1.0B and NODA AI at $125M—and the stage heterogeneity within the comp set, with two Series A valuations anchoring a seed-stage target. Material gaps in disclosed financials, customer traction, and technology differentiation further limit precision. Additional revenue or funding trajectory data would narrow this range materially.
